decisions.reason: Premium support draws directly on the firm's existing hosting and technical service know-how. That makes it easy to absorb and improve through customer feedback, although service tiers are often restructured.

The version manager extends the firm's existing tool family (security center, restore manager), so it builds on deep in-house software knowledge. The firm can readily interpret and refine its results.

The GDPR contract tool relies on legal knowledge only loosely related to the firm's technical core, which limits absorptive capacity. It still adds compliance value for hosting customers, who need data processing contracts.
Scalable agency hosting sits squarely within the firm's core hosting competence. Management can assimilate market signals and improve it with its own development.
